name: Thriller CCTV
tagline: heditor's thriller: CCTV tape on black, phosphor green, lowercase film subtitles, one keyword blinking red.

motion.direction: heditor `thriller`. Surveillance tape: scanlines, a timecode-style `chapterCard` in mono, lowercase film subtitles (Inter 600) as the captions, and one keyword per sentence that blinks to red `goldd` or phosphor `ter`. Poster lines are rare, lowercase, 90–120 px, cut in and out hard; numbers are mono `counter`s; a `stamp` EVIDENCE / CASE CLOSED on verdicts; a `focusRing` isolates what the speaker names. Camera still, cuts only, amber `gold` for warnings. Quiet, tense, never shouting.
